walled_core.note: Generalized rectangle for the Ming-walled core; not a surveyed wall polygon, administrative boundary, or hotel search radius.

central_focus.note: Regional-panel box identifies the separately enlarged central inset; it does not define central Xi'an.

line_2_orientation.note: Simplified north-south Line 2 orientation in the central inset; not track geometry, stops, service hours, or a hotel route.

lines_3_4_anchor.note: Big Wild Goose Pagoda area interchange anchor; no complete line geometry or transfer promise is shown.

regional_anchors.note: Bell Tower position anchors the central inset but is not treated as the destination of every stay.
Station-building centroid from the reviewed arrival map; plazas, exits, and pickup zones remain on-site decisions.
Declared midpoint reused from the reviewed Chapter 7 choice map; not a district boundary, station, hotel, or entrance.

zones.anchor: Bell Tower and old-core street network
zones.note: Zone marker is an itinerary anchor, not a hotel boundary or guarantee of walkability.
Gate position reused from the reviewed inside-wall route; the stay area extends beyond this point and has no hard boundary.
Big Wild Goose Pagoda is a durable area anchor; the marker does not define the full Yanta or Qujiang districts.
Station anchor does not imply that any hotel using the North Station name is walkable to the concourse.
Declared itinerary midpoint; not a specific hotel or Line 9 station.

OLD-CORE DAYS · CHECK LANE,
DOOR AND NIGHT NOISE

cards.title: SOUTH GATE

cards.title: YANTA / QUJIANG
cards.zh: 雁塔、博物馆、夜间散步；接受回老城更远。

PAGODA + MUSEUMS + EVENING ·
LONGER RETURN TO THE WALL

cards.title: XI'AN NORTH
cards.zh: 只为早晚高铁：所谓“附近”不等于能走到。
cards.ja: 早朝・夜の高速鉄道向け。「近い」と徒歩圏は別。
cards.en: EARLY / LATE HSR · NEARBY DOES NOT MEAN WALKABLE

cards.title: LINTONG
cards.zh: 两天向东才考虑：把搬酒店也算进行程。
cards.ja: 東側を二日使う時だけ。宿替えの手間も数える。
cards.en: TWO EASTERN DAYS · COUNT THE HOTEL MOVE

visual_qa.notes: Inspected at the 5600 x 6160 master, a 1476-pixel B6 landscape proof, and a 900-pixel mobile zoom proof matching the website's enlarged map view. All five numbered zones, the central inset, trilingual cards, wall, and selected transport anchors remain distinct; labels stay inside their panels and no line claims a complete route or hotel boundary.
